The Bisons, led by 2nd-year head coach [[Lennie Acuff]], played their home games at the [[Allen Arena]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]]. They finished the season 15-12, 9-6 in [[2020–21 ASUN Conference men's basketball season|ASUN Play]] to finish in 3rd place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 ASUN men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] to [[2020–21 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Bisons]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 16–16, 9–7 in ASUN play to finish in a tie for third place. In the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]], the #3 seeded Bisons defeated the #6 seed [[2019–20 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]], 68–63,{{Cite news|url=https://lipscombsports.com/news/2020/3/3/IMPORTED_STORY_16661_16661.aspx|title=Asadullah's 40-point statement sends Lipscomb to the ASUN
